data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 reduces to SRC_005: the fragmented-oversight mechanism reduces to the formal condition that decentralized nodes share a critical dependency (e.g., a shared DNS provider, shared time sync, shared cryptographic library), but the reduction is refuted if oversight fragmentation is shown to cause correlated failure through lack of coordinated response even when the dependency DAG is sparse and no single shared cause is identifiable.
